{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values
print("\nNumber of -1 in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("\nSample of revenue:", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for QA orders
print("\nUnique revenue values:", df['revenue'].unique())

# Check status
print("\nStatus distribution:", df['status'].value_counts())

# Check channels
print("\nChannel distribution:", df['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment
print("\nCustomer segment distribution:", df['customer_segment'].value_counts())"}
